confirmed_task: On Google Flights, search for a round trip from New Delhi to Bengaluru for September 15–18, 2026, for one adult in economy. Apply the nonstop filter, compare the three lowest visible options by airline, departure time, duration, and round-trip fare, and report the best balance of price and schedule without booking.

items.criterion: Use Google Flights to run the specified search (route, dates, passengers, cabin) or clearly report access issues
items.description: Attempt a Google Flights search for a round trip from New Delhi (DEL) to Bengaluru (BLR) for Sept 15–18, 2026, for 1 adult in economy. Full credit if all parameters match exactly. Full credit also if the agent navigates to Google Flights but cannot complete the search due to external issues (captcha, site down, blocked, missing inventory for far-future dates) and clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent uses Google Flights but has a minor mismatch (e.g., wrong airport/city pairing or wrong cabin) and clearly notes the discrepancy.

items.criterion: Apply the nonstop filter (direct flights only) or clearly report inability to do so
items.description: Apply/enable the nonstop (0 stops/direct) filter on Google Flights and ensure compared results are nonstop. Full credit if nonstop filtering is applied and results shown are verified nonstop. Full credit also if the agent attempts to apply the nonstop filter but cannot due to UI/platform limitations or blocked access and clearly reports what happened and what was done instead (e.g., manually selecting only clearly labeled nonstop flights). No credit if the agent compares itineraries with stops without noting that nonstop was required when nonstop options are available/visible.

items.criterion: Identify and compare the lowest-priced visible nonstop options (up to three) given available results
items.description: From the nonstop-filtered results, select the three lowest-priced visible options and compare them. Full credit if the agent compares the three lowest visible at the time of review. If fewer than three nonstop options are visible/available (or results fail to load), full credit for comparing all available lowest-priced options and explicitly stating the limitation. Partial credit if the agent compares fewer than the available lowest-priced options without explanation, or picks options that are not among the lowest visible without justification (ties acceptable).

items.criterion: Report required details for each compared option (airline, departure time, duration, round-trip fare) or clearly note missing fields
items.description: For each of the compared lowest-priced options, provide: (1) airline, (2) departure time(s) (outbound and return, or clearly specified), (3) duration, and (4) round-trip total fare. Full credit if all four elements are provided for all compared options and match what is visible on Google Flights. Partial credit if one element is missing for one option, or if Google Flights does not display a field (e.g., fare not shown until expanding) and the agent clearly states that it was not visible/available.

items.criterion: Recommend the best balance of price and schedule (no booking)
items.description: Provide a reasoned recommendation selecting the best balance of price and schedule based on the compared options, explicitly weighing fare vs. departure times/duration, and do not book or proceed to checkout. Full credit if the recommendation is justified and consistent with the comparison, or if the agent explains that a recommendation is not possible because results/details were unavailable (e.g., blocked access) while still summarizing what could be observed.
